title: News report of the Oklahoma City bombing

tellings.quote: >> A massive car bomb exploded outside of a large federal building in downtown Oklahoma City, shattering that building, killing children, killing federal employees, military men, and civilians.

plain: In 1995, a huge car bomb went off outside a large federal building in downtown Oklahoma City. It wrecked the building and killed children, federal workers, soldiers and civilians. These words come from a clip of an unnamed news reporter that was played during an episode about a scientist who studies objects he says were implanted in people's bodies.
